list.description: A player takes less of an energy hit when performing consecutive dribble moves. allowing them to chain together combos quicker and for longer periods.
list.name: Handles For Days

list.description: Speeds up launches when attacking from the perimeter.
list.name: Lightning Launch

list.description: Defenders have a tougher time poking the ball free with their steal attempts.
list.name: Unpluckable

list.description: Improves a player's ability to thread and fit tight passes, including alley-oops, quickly and on time.
list.name: Versatile Visionary

list.description: Passing out of a jump shot or layup yields fewer errant passes than normal. Additionally, it helps with passing out of double teams.
list.name: Bail Out

list.description: Reduces the likelihood of being bothered by defenders when dribbling.
list.name: Strong Handle

list.description: Boosts the speed and leaping ability of a defensive player in anticipation of a block attempt.
list.name: High-Flying Denier

list.description: Allows players to quickly recover and go back up for another jump upon landing. This could be after a rebound, block attempt, or even jump shot.
list.name: Pogo Stick
